controls.fixtures: run-owned only; durable manifest, two scoped tenants and governed Projects
controls.as_of_clock: 2026-10-20T12:00:00Z for local fixtures; record an explicit live UTC clock at execution
controls.revisions: capture requirements/source SHA, authority source revision, relationship/mapping revisions and schema head before each attempt
controls.cleanup: delete only run-owned fixtures through owning API, independently verify absence; preserve receipts/history; failed cleanup is incomplete
controls.report: AC -> scenario/test -> run/attempt -> result/evidence -> source/requirements revision; separate surface reports

scenarios.given: Two Products in distinct governed Projects and two optional Portfolios; one Initiative shared across Products; explicit source revision and effective/decision clocks
scenarios.when: Create Commerce->Checkout, Commerce->Accounts, Shared->Accounts; write one Initiative x Product x Project commitment; close one membership with a new relationship revision; retry duplicate and invalid-dated writes
then: Authorized independent readback shows Commerce with Checkout and Accounts and Shared with Accounts; one Product belongs to two Portfolios without a nested Portfolio.
Duplicate current Initiative x Product x Project commitments and duplicate Portfolio/Product membership are rejected without another receipt/change or native work copy.

At an as-of effective time before closure, prior membership remains visible under the decision-time revision; after closure it is absent, and immutable recorded history keeps both relationship versions.
Invalid intervals and stale supersedes revisions fail without changing current state; no Portfolio allocation target is created.
scenarios.independent_observation: new authorized API session reads history at pinned effective/recorded clocks; verify native backlog and allocation service are unchanged
scenarios.evidence: catalog_contract_examples with source/requirements revision, recorded attempt and cleanup receipts

scenarios.given: One actor currently sees two overlapping governed Project projections; another Project is foreign; a formerly permitted Project and source can be revoked before page two
scenarios.when: List authorized Portfolios at limit 1, follow the signed cursor, list member edges, mutate one permitted Project; retry the old cursor after revocation and request foreign/unknown IDs, stale write and revoked source
then: Independent Project-scoped readback yields Commerce once despite two projections and Shared once; authorized member edges only and no hidden total count or copied native work.
A valid second page contains Shared, not a duplicate Commerce; revoked or expired cursors are rejected without an unauthorized cached result.
A foreign Portfolio ID and an unknown ID return the identical public 404 body; foreign member and revoked-source reads do not disclose names, counts or IDs.
Only a caller with catalog edit and the current Product/Project write grant can mutate a visible member; foreign/revoked/stale writes produce no receipt, change, permission grant or new work item.
scenarios.independent_observation: new authorized API session under each actor/scope after each grant change, compare Project authority and source entitlement, independently inspect work and mutation receipts
scenarios.evidence: catalog_scope_contract with separate actor/surface attempts, source/requirements revision, denial/readback and cleanup receipts

scenarios.given: Gateway catalog unit selected as proposed owner; existing gateway migration/deploy path inspected; implementation artifacts, approved target and live fixture authority are not assumed
scenarios.when: Review pinned gateway routes, Alembic and workflow source; after implementation/approved target, record migration result, served artifact identities, source/requirements revision and fixture manifest, exercise catalog read/write through real surface, then recovery under existing approval
then: Repository audit identifies the Gateway catalog API/PostgreSQL owner and real CI, pre-serving migration and deploy workflow; no new runtime pipeline or synthetic endpoint is asserted.

Before live admissions, independent deployment observation matches reviewed source/workflow SHA, schema head and gateway image digest; separately published CLI/UI artifact identities are recorded when exercised.

Additive migrations retain catalog history/receipts and an incompatible or failed migration does not enable new writes; disable admissions before a compatible rollback and independently read back accepted history.

Only run-owned fixture resources are removed from the durable manifest; independent source/owner readback confirms cleanup without deleting reused assets or retained audit receipts. A missing target, mismatched revision or failed cleanup remains incomplete.
scenarios.independent_observation: pinned repository workflow audit now; later authorized gateway deployment receipt and fresh API/source/fixture-owner readback after each release or rollback
scenarios.evidence: catalog_rollout_decision plus source/requirements revision, distinct pre-review observation, later separate V12 run/attempt/surface report and durable cleanup receipts
